facts.fact: The GOV.CV portal page says a tax identification number (NIF) can be requested online through the portal or app, first issue free, issued within up to 2 working days.
The PEO company-creation package includes obtaining the Tax Identification Number (NIF) from DNRE, and the platform interoperates with the tax administration.
The NIF is obtained within the same PEO package as commercial registry formalisation and social security enrolment.

note: The minister mentions citizens being asked for the taxpayer number in passing; no taxpayer register is described.
